name: agentpad13-behavior-sim
description: Referees for the shipped agentpad13 UF2s on rp2040js. behavior.cjs: full 13-switch sweep, encoder, TTP223 touch polarity, joystick ADC->HID gamepad, and per-index LED addressability read back from the ws2812 DMA buffer. joystick.cjs: the protocol-v1 calibration commands 0x50/0x51/0x52, their rejection classes, and EEPROM persistence across a simulated power cycle. Reuses ../tests/emulator/node_modules; no dependencies of its own. Both harnesses carry A/B arms that MUST fail, which is what proves they discriminate: behavior.cjs --touch=firmware (4 failures) and --encoder=firmware (2 failures), joystick.cjs --no-eeprom and --no-adc-fix. The default arms (--touch=board --encoder=board, both emulator workarounds on) are the gates.

scripts.sim:all: npm run sim:default && npm run sim:vial && npm run joystick:default && npm run joystick:vial
